tokens.name: cloud-dancer
tokens.usage: Pantone 11-4201 Cloud Dancer (colour of the year 2026), a warm off-white. Pantone publishes no official screen value; this is the common digital approximation. The light ground, and the text colour on dark.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Brand black, a near-black with a trace of violet. The dark ground, and the text colour on light.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground: Cloud Dancer in light, black in dark. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`, `ink-subtle`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and inputs resting on `background`. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`, `ink-subtle`.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Resting fills: secondary buttons, tags, empty areas, disabled ground. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`, `ink-subtle`.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers. Decorative separation only: 1.3:1 on light `background`, so never the only cue for a control edge.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `background`, `surface`, `surface-muted`, `green-soft` and `purple-soft` (10.7:1 or better in both themes). Also the fill of bold black blocks.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `background`, `surface`, `surface-muted`, `green-soft` and `purple-soft` (5.8:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Quietest text (captions, hints) on the same grounds as `ink-muted`; 4.5:1 or better in both themes. Do not go lighter.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: The action colour: primary buttons, links, selected and active states, progress. Fill with `on-green` text; as text on `background`, `surface`, `surface-muted` and `green-soft` it holds 4.6:1 or better in light and 6.4:1 in dark.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `green` fill: white on light green (5.9:1), black on bright dark-mode green (9.7:1).

tokens.name: green-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet green tint for selected rows, chips and success-leaning highlights. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`, `green`.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: The spark colour: highlights, rewards and achievements, featured or new labels, and the keyboard focus ring (6.3:1 or better on every ground). Use it sparingly, never as a second action colour next to `green`.

tokens.name: on-purple
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `purple` fill: white on light purple (8.4:1), black on bright dark-mode purple (8.2:1).

tokens.name: purple-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet purple tint behind a highlighted block or badge. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`, `purple`.

tokens.name: marigold
tokens.usage: The warm accent: a sunny yellow-orange that relieves the cool green, purple and black. Fills for badges, streaks, highlights, charts and illustration. Never a primary action fill. Label on it: `on-marigold`.

tokens.name: on-marigold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `marigold` (9.9:1 light, 11.0:1 dark). Always black, never white.

tokens.name: marigold-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet warm background for a note, callout, streak chip or highlighted row. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`, or `marigold-text`.

tokens.name: marigold-text
tokens.usage: Warm-coloured text and icons on `background`, `surface`, `surface-muted` and `marigold-soft` (4.6:1 or better in both themes). Marigold itself is too light to read as text on light grounds.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error and destructive actions: a raspberry red. Fill for error badges and destructive buttons (label `on-error`), and also readable as text and icons on `background`, `surface`, `surface-muted` and `error-soft` (4.8:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `error` (6.1:1 light, 7.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: error-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet background for an error message, failed row or invalid field. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`, or `error`.

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (Green). Fixed order, never cycled; a 6th series folds into 'Other'. Never a status colour. Text beside a mark stays in `ink`.

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (Purple). Fixed order, never cycled; a 6th series folds into 'Other'. Never a status colour. Text beside a mark stays in `ink`.

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (Marigold). Fixed order, never cycled; a 6th series folds into 'Other'. Never a status colour. Text beside a mark stays in `ink`. Contrast on `surface` is 2.9:1 in light, so always pair with direct labels or a table view.

tokens.name: data-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (Blue). Fixed order, never cycled; a 6th series folds into 'Other'. Never a status colour. Text beside a mark stays in `ink`.

tokens.name: data-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 (Orange). Fixed order, never cycled; a 6th series folds into 'Other'. Never a status colour. Text beside a mark stays in `ink`.

tokens.name: data-seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 1 of 6, low to high magnitude. One hue only; in dark mode low values are dark and high values light.

tokens.name: data-seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 2 of 6, low to high magnitude. One hue only; in dark mode low values are dark and high values light.

tokens.name: data-seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 3 of 6, low to high magnitude. One hue only; in dark mode low values are dark and high values light.

tokens.name: data-seq-4
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 4 of 6, low to high magnitude. One hue only; in dark mode low values are dark and high values light.

tokens.name: data-seq-5
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 5 of 6, low to high magnitude. One hue only; in dark mode low values are dark and high values light.

tokens.name: data-seq-6
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 6 of 6, low to high magnitude. One hue only; in dark mode low values are dark and high values light.
